title: Management tone per company/quarter, kept across runs
note: One entry per company/quarter, for every quarter ever classified - not just the current window. A run only asks the model about quarters it does not already have a tone for, and a null never overwrites a real tone. Each tone is a reading of that quarter's own concall, with the quote it rests on. Delete a cell (or run with --refresh) to force re-classification.

Q3 FY25.signal: Management is confident about increasing production volumes with new wells and partnerships, expecting no decline for a decade.
